bugs.error_message: InvalidAccessKeyId: The key '005c37957e...' is not valid (HTTP 403) on B2 PutObject/ListBuckets
bugs.root_cause: B2_ENDPOINT/B2_REGION were us-west-004 but bucket tiger-builder lives in us-east-005 (s3ApiUrl from b2_authorize_account). Credentials were valid for native B2 API.
bugs.fix: Set B2_ENDPOINT=https://s3.us-east-005.backblazeb2.com and B2_REGION=us-east-005; also set requestChecksumCalculation/responseChecksumValidation to WHEN_REQUIRED for AWS SDK v3 + B2.
